# S2.4 — Egress mediation with attribution + the credential broker's mediation surface: `decide_egress`/`EgressMediator`, `security.egress.*`, `network.calls` charge-before-wire, `mediate`/`minted_scoped`/`rotate`/`virtualize_for_fork`, revocation intents (R-2.8.3, R-2.8.4)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.3 + §5g.4
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/035_S2.4__egress-mediation-and-credentials.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.3** · **R-2.8.4**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s2.3` (stacked) · **Stage:** 2 ·
**Live stage:** operator-gated egress — discharged as hermetic loopback
fixtures (the 158e56e gate decision; real `TcpStream`, no non-local
egress)

## Summary

The egress mediator and the credential broker's mediation surface land.
The PDP is pure (`hh-containment::egress::decide_egress` — the normative
decision order); the CDP is the runtime (`hh-env::egress::EgressMediator`
— durable rows, resolve-only attribution tokens, sentinel mediation,
budget gating, ask/endorsement, the single `EgressTransport` wire).
Every refusal path is durable-first and fail-closed; no secret value
ever reaches a durable surface or the wire except substituted for a
host in its own binding.

### `crates/hh-containment` (new modules)

- `egress` — `decide_egress` in the normative order: mode →
  attribution → deny (host **and** resolved addresses) → non-public →
  protocol/port/method → allow → approval-cache → `default_unmatched`.
  Host normalization (case, trailing dot, brackets/zone-ID; `*.apex` ≠
  `apex`); bare `*` deny rejected at `validate` (`GlobalDenyRule`);
  `non_public` classifier + SSRF recheck on fresh answers;
  `ApprovalCache` narrowing-only, `idp_id`-keyed, policy-version-pinned.
- `amend` — endorsement-lease → bounded narrowing-only
  `security.containment.amended` under `persist_scope_ceiling`.
- `events` — `egress_requested_payload`/`egress_decided_payload`
  (refs + token hash, never values).

### `crates/hh-env` (new module + driver wiring)

- `egress` — `EgressMediator`: `security.egress.requested`
  (`sentinel_refs`) durable before decision; `decided` durable before
  the outcome is visible; resolve-only `TokenResolver` (unknown /
  expired / env-mismatch ⇒ `deny{unattributed}`); fresh resolution +
  non-public recheck; `mediate_placeholder` per sentinel (env-handle
  binding, destination coverage, path ambiguity, consume-once drain,
  carrier rewrite — anti-laundering by the credential's own binding,
  not the rule's say-so); `network.calls` pre-gated and charged to the
  decided row before the wire; ask → `security.permission.{pending,
  requested}` + `decided{ask}`; endorse `{allow_once | deny | lease}`;
  approvals exhaustion ⇒ `deny{budget_exhausted}`; `RevokeIntent`
  dispatched through mediated egress to `revocation_path`.
- `LocalHttpTransport` — real HTTP/1.1 over `TcpStream` to the checked
  address (`tls.terminate` honestly `false` → DF-S2.4-2);
  `SystemResolver`/`StaticResolver`.
- `driver` — `rebind_credentials_for_fork` (child-side placeholder
  rebind).

### `crates/hh-secrets`

- `broker` — `mint`/`minted_scoped` + `verify_minted` (kernel-keyed
  MAC over `binding ∥ audience ∥ expires`; liveness/revocation fencing
  ⇒ `Expired`/`Revoked`); `rotate` CAS with every historical value
  retained in the mask set; `drain_claim` consume-once;
  `virtualize_for_fork` (fresh `(child_run, binding)` spellings);
  `env_spec_for`; `leak_scan_run`.
- `channel` — `DestinationBinding.revocation_path`.

### `crates/hh-ledger`

- `classes` — `security.egress.{requested,decided}` +
  `security.containment.amended` audit classes; `sentinel_refs` audit
  member (additive, CC8).
